response.query: How can capacity-building and benefit-sharing be operationalized into measurable deliverables (number of workshops, training hours, co-authored outputs, data-access policy) and monitored?
response.answer: Capacity-building and benefit-sharing can be operationalized through workshops, training hours, co-authored outputs, and data-access policies, monitored via attendance records, participant feedback, publication counts, and policy compliance checks.
